summary.text: Sharlett Mena is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 29-Position 2 since January 9, 2023, and she is a candidate for Washington State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election against fellow Democrat David Anderson.
Her career experience includes communications work for members of Congress, for Jay Inslee, and for the state Senate Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Mena was born in the Tri-Cities, Washington, and lives in Tacoma.

She earned a B.A. in communications and philosophy from Washington State University in 2011, studied abroad at University College Cork in 2010, and completed American University's Women in Politics Institute's WeLead program in 2015.

She worked in communications for U.S. Representatives Albio Sires and Gene Green, for Jay Inslee in his 2016 campaign for governor and when he was governor, as a communications specialist for the Senate Democratic Caucus, and as a special assistant to the director of the Washington State Department of Ecology.
Mena co-created Voter Turnup and has served on the boards of the South Tacoma Neighborhood Council, Fuse Washington, Progreso and the Planned Parenthood Votes Washington Political Action Committee.

She succeeded Steve Kirby (D) in the House, and in the 2023-2024 session was vice chair of the Environment & Energy Committee and served on the State Government & Tribal Relations and House Transportation committees.
